name: War on the Woodpaw
summary: At Camp Mojache, Hadoken Swiftstrider calls the gnolls a lasting danger to the camp itself, with attacks growing more fevered of late. Hadoken asks you for ten Woodpaw Gnoll Manes to thin their numbers.

sections.title: A Threat to the Camp
sections.body: To Hadoken, it makes no difference whether the gnolls belong in Feralas. If the camp does not harden its resolve, he warns, it will be pushed out of the whole region. With the attacks on the camp growing more fevered, he wants their numbers thinned and offers generous pay for ten Woodpaw gnoll manes.

sections.title: Hadoken's Response
sections.body: Hadoken calls the manes a good start. He has put the same ask to others; many have fought the gnolls before, and past efforts held them back. Lately the gnolls have pushed north into the area the camp holds sway over far more often, and their attacks have turned savage, almost desperate. Hadoken says he has a plan that might settle the matter.

faq.q: Why is Camp Mojache targeting the Woodpaw gnolls?
faq.answer: Hadoken regards them as a constant danger to the camp, with attacks growing more fevered, and fears the camp will be driven out of the whole region unless it stands firm.
